'''Adacin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
During the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] of [[3636 BBY]] Adacin and her constant companion [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Zanisk]] went into hiding to avoid fighting the [[Eternal Empire]] and remained hidden when [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Darth Acina]] signed the [[Zakuul–Imperial treaty]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Alliance Intelligence Report: Lords Adacin and Zanisk}}</ref> Following the death of Empress [[Vaylin]] and formation of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in [[3630 BBY]], Adacin and Zanisk re-emerged as leaders of an Imperial splinter faction. They set up their base inside the former [[Separatist stronghold]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] and began attacking nearby systems that were allied with the Alliance. This eventually prompted the Alliance to [[Adacin and Zanisk's uprising|retaliate]] and in defending their base against the assault, both Adacin and Zanisk were killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Adacin appears in the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'', during the final boss fight of the "Inferno" Uprising.
